ray_extraction_message: Exact endpoints connected by a descending FMM seed
source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider catalog geometry reference, not a simulated pick/origin identifier
source_simulation_origin_time_basis: truth t=0; initial/inverted t is a simulated correction in seconds
receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs
native_source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider catalog geometry reference, not a simulated pick/origin identifier
native_source_simulation_origin_time_bas: truth t=0; initial/inverted t is a simulated correction in seconds
native_receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
native_receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
native_receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
native_receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs
observation_index_basis: local original event-times-receiver pair index, not a provider observation ID
